conceptual assets.information: The conditional-operation result is the value copied from rs1_i when the command and condition are true, or zero otherwise. The CPU depends on it as the coprocessor's returned result.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The result may contain sensitive processor data and is exposed through res_o when rs1_i is copied at line 54. The result can be changed by the sampled operand or control decisions at lines 53-56. A false command or condition can withhold the intended result by selecting zero at lines 53-57.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could observe res_o to learn the operand or alter the operand or control inputs so that the result is replaced with zero or another incorrect value.

conceptual assets.information: The conditional-execution decision is formed from whether rs2_i equals zero and ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1). It determines whether the operation result selects rs1_i or zero.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: The decision can be modified through the comparison inputs at lines 62-63 and then changes the value selected for res_o at lines 53-56. Altering the decision can block the intended result by forcing the zero path at lines 55-56.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could alter rs2_i or the relevant instruction control bit so the unit selects zero instead of the intended operand or selects the operand under the wrong condition.

conceptual assets.information: This is the indication that the instruction-control decode represents the supported conditional operation. The CPU uses it through valid_o to recognize the operation and accept its result; it is generated internally from operation-selector fields rather than carried through a separate data port.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: An incorrect decode can corrupt the validity indication delivered on valid_o at lines 41-43 and 66. Deasserting the decoded validity suppresses both valid_o and the result update through lines 53-57 and 66.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could alter the instruction-control decode or validity path so a supported operation is rejected, or an unsupported operation is reported as valid.

considered, not kept.reason: Clock and reset inputs are expressly excluded conceptual assets; they only time or reset res_o at lines 50-52.
